mutations.note: Widget name constant off by a character: applyImageSeed never finds the widget.
Default node class misspelled: seedsFromPrompt matches nothing by default.
Object.entries/keys confusion: destructuring a string key yields undefined entries.
continue -> break: one non-matching node aborts the scan, later seeds dropped.
Optional chaining removed: a missing inputs object throws instead of skipping.
Default parameter dropped: the one-argument call matches no class_type.
typeof compared to the wrong string: inverts which values are accepted.

mutations.note: `in` -> hasOwnProperty: a value on a prototype falls through to the raw object.
